summary: Backend-only testing for NammaRoad iteration 3. Added 9 new pytest cases (5 BBMP invite-code, 4 WebSocket broadcast) to /app/backend/tests/test_nammaroad_backend.py and updated 2 existing login tests to send the invite code. Ran full suite: 30/30 PASS in ~3.6s. Invite-code gating works (admin/engineer 403 without/wrong code, 200 with BBMP-2026, citizens unaffected). WebSocket /api/ws accepts connections, emits initial hello, and broadcasts pothole_created / status_updated / upvoted events with the correct payload shape.
action_items: Frontend (Expo) is still served via ngrok tunnel and tunnel reports ERR_NGROK_334 ('endpoint already online'). Web preview at https://road-report-live.preview.emergentagent.com (Kubernetes ingress) may still front HTTP but pure-WS upgrades through it were not validated here; tests use ws://localhost:8001/api/ws as instructed. Main agent should confirm Kubernetes ingress proxies wss:// for the frontend useLiveUpdates hook in production preview.

Frontend UI checks for invite-code field visibility and LIVE indicator were NOT performed (testing_type=backend only and tunnel is currently failing). Main agent can self-verify via the Expo Go app or by running browser preview after tunnel recovers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login: invite_code is trimmed but case-sensitive — fine, matches spec ('BBMP-2026').
WSManager uses asyncio.Lock + Set[WebSocket] with dead-socket cleanup — solid; broadcasts run sequentially (await per socket) which is OK for current scale.
/api/ws is registered on `app` directly (not under api_router). This is intentional because APIRouter.websocket has prefix quirks; current path /api/ws is correct.
All previous review items (env-driven URLs, _id exclusion, async I/O, testID usage) remain satisfied.
seed_data_creation: Reused /api/seed (8 sample potholes, 3 demo users: bbmp-admin-token, engineer-token, citizen-token). Test users created with TEST_ prefix and dummy 9999*** phone numbers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ws://localhost:8001/api/ws for websocket tests (Kubernetes ingress wss not verified end-to-end). Invite code is BBMP-2026 (from /app/backend/.env). To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_nammaroad_backend.py -v`. websockets==16.0 is already installed. Frontend ngrok tunnel was throwing ERR_NGROK_334 throughout this run; if frontend UI testing is requested next, the tunnel needs to be restarted.
